result.title: Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock
result.summary: Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred. We find that two benchmarks for this task largely reward knowing when rather than seeing what: a timer that never looks at the video, raising an alarm at 25 s and confirming each step at 30 s, reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373 on Ego-MC-Bench, above every published result (at most 0.27). We formalize this as the video-blind frontier, the best trade-off between completion accuracy and mistake F1 that policies reach from the elapsed time, the instruction and training statistics alone: every published per-step result on Ego-MC-Bench lies inside it, and so do all twelve zero-shot models we run on QICD. To move beyond it, we introduce Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT): fine-tune on the benchmark's own questions, and pair its positives with negatives from the same recording at the same elapsed time, so that elapsed time cannot separate the two sides of a pair. Trained on 209 QICD videos in about 15 GPU-hours, a 2B model with ECT crosses the frontier on both benchmarks in all four seeds; transferred to Ego-MC-Bench without adaptation, it confirms 59% of mistake-free steps in time, against 30% for a published model with the same backbone trained on about 25k synthetic counterfactuals and real recordings. Its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains: at equal elapsed time it tells a finished step from an unfinished one in 90-92% of test pairs, where the instruction's typical duration reaches 65%, rescaling the time stamps between the frames leaves it essentially unchanged, and swapping in another recording, of the same recipe where one exists, cuts its completion accuracy by two thirds. The code and model weights will be publicly released.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出两个主动式任务辅助基准主要奖励「知道何时」而非「看到什么」：一个完全不看视频、仅按固定时间报警与确认步骤的计时器在 Ego-MC-Bench 上取得 0.373 的 mistake F1，超过所有已发表结果。作者将其形式化为 video-blind frontier，并提出 Evidence-Contrastive Training，用同一录像、同一已用时刻的负样本配对进行微调，使时间无法区分正负，2B 模型在约 15 GPU 小时内于两个基准的四个随机种子上均越过该前沿，并通过等时间配对判别、时间戳重标定与换录像等实验显示决策确实跟随视频内容。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应 LVR 关注的「视觉旁路与信息坍缩」诊断及「何时停止、证据是否足够」决策问题；其等时间对比负采样可能可供核查为抑制时间先验捷径、强化视觉证据使用的训练线索。
